description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE March 14, 2026 (Colorado Springs, CO) — The Victor Marx for Governor campaign is honored to announce that Republican candidate Victor Marx has accepted an invitation to be a featured speaker at the International Faith Summit during CPAC USA 2026, taking place Wednesday, March 25th, at the Gaylord Texan Resort & Convention Center in Grapevine, Texas.
